supersededAttempt.change: Limit unresolved-import diagnostic paths to the first eight plus remaining count.
supersededAttempt.effect: All non-dynamic fixtures have no unresolved import and dynamic fixture has one; expected result is unchanged for these fixtures. This intermediate attempt was aborted because its dynamic different-base assertion was wrong; final benchmark was restarted after source stabilization. No timings from the abandoned attempt are included.

scope: Isolated impact analysis microbenchmark and regression inventory; not a complete Issue-to-PR/Delivery performance acceptance.

limitations: This measures computeImpactSet first/repeat/different-base calls only, not an Issue end-to-end workflow, LLM work, review quality, test execution, CI or delivery.
No provider token usage or cost was collected; no token saving is claimed.
Fresh process per side and repetition; first call includes compiler initialization. Process timing includes loader and process startup. OS caches are not flushed.
Five repetitions are a small sample; p95 is nearest-rank and equals max for n=5.
Run order alternates; shared host load can affect measurements.
